speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Abdominal_X-Ray: Dilated bowel segments with absence of gas in the rectum, suggesting a possible obstruction; Clinical history indicates no passage of stool or flatus.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Midgut Volvulus. The combination of an 8-month-old with bilious vomiting signs, lower abdominal tenderness, and X-ray findings of dilated bowel with no distal gas/flatus passage is highly indicative of a mechanical obstruction, specifically volvulus.
